Methods for postcard_power and postcard_samplesize objects

Source: R/postcard_power_methods.R
postcard_power_methods.Rd

power_gs, power_nc, and power_marginaleffect() return objects of class postcard_power. samplesize_gs() returns an object of class postcard_samplesize. Both classes are lists holding the primary numeric output (power or samplesize) together with the assumptions used to compute it. print and summary methods for both classes are provided. A plot method is provided for postcard_power objects, showing the approximate sampling distributions of the estimator under the null and alternative hypotheses with the power shaded.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'postcard_power'
print(x, digits = max(3L, getOption("digits") - 3L), ...)

# S3 method for class 'postcard_power'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary.postcard_power'
print(x, digits = max(3L, getOption("digits") - 3L), ...)

# S3 method for class 'postcard_power'
plot(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'postcard_samplesize'
print(x, digits = max(3L, getOption("digits") - 3L), ...)

# S3 method for class 'postcard_samplesize'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary.postcard_samplesize'
print(x, digits = max(3L, getOption("digits") - 3L), ...)

Arguments

x

an object of class postcard_power or postcard_samplesize (or the corresponding summary.* class).

digits

a numeric with the number of digits to display when printing.

...

additional arguments (currently unused).

object

an object of class postcard_power or postcard_samplesize.

Value

print methods return their input invisibly. summary methods return an object of class summary.postcard_power or summary.postcard_samplesize respectively, which extends the input class with additional information (currently just the deparsed estimand function) displayed by the corresponding print method. plot.postcard_power returns a ggplot2 object.

See also

power_gs(), power_nc(), samplesize_gs(), power_marginaleffect().
